import urllib.request
import json
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis

def get_uniprot_entry(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

ficd = get_uniprot_entry("Q9BVA6")
pgm1 = get_uniprot_entry("P36871")

ficd_seq = ficd['sequence']['value']
ficd_mw_entry = ficd['sequence']['molWeight']
ficd_calc = ProteinAnalysis(ficd_seq).molecular_weight()

pgm1_seq = pgm1['sequence']['value']
pgm1_mw_entry = pgm1['sequence']['molWeight']
pgm1_calc = ProteinAnalysis(pgm1_seq).molecular_weight()

print(f"FICD (Q9BVA6):")
print(f"  Length: {len(ficd_seq)} aa")
print(f"  UniProt molWeight: {ficd_mw_entry} Da ({ficd_mw_entry/1000:.2f} kDa)")
print(f"  Calculated MW: {ficd_calc:.2f} Da ({ficd_calc/1000:.2f} kDa)")

print(f"PGM1 (P36871):")
print(f"  Length: {len(pgm1_seq)} aa")
print(f"  UniProt molWeight: {pgm1_mw_entry} Da ({pgm1_mw_entry/1000:.2f} kDa)")
print(f"  Calculated MW: {pgm1_calc:.2f} Da ({pgm1_calc/1000:.2f} kDa)")
